message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Massenkommunikation in der DDR 1985 (Media Use in the GDR 1985)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA6315","justification":"Survey on mass communication and media use in the GDR, fielded in 1985, directly focused on media in the German Democratic Republic during the 1980s."},{"title":"Mediennutzung und politische Einstellungen in der DDR 1983 (Media Use and Political Attitudes in the GDR 1983)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8298","justification":"Dataset on media consumption and political attitudes in the GDR, conducted in 1983, covering media in the GDR during the early 1980s."},{"title":"Presse und Rundfunk in der DDR 1987 (Press and Broadcasting in the GDR 1987)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8462","justification":"Empirical study about press and broadcasting structures and reception in the GDR, fielded in 1987, squarely within the 1980s timeframe."},{"title":"Fernsehnutzung in der DDR 1988 (Television Use in the GDR 1988)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8921","justification":"Survey focused on television viewing behavior in the GDR in 1988, directly about media behavior in the late 1980s."},{"title":"Presselektüre und Radiokonsum in der DDR 1982 (Press Reading and Radio Consumption in the GDR 1982)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7914","justification":"Dataset on press and radio use in the GDR, conducted in 1982, capturing everyday media practices in the early 1980s."},{"title":"Medien und Öffentlichkeit in der DDR 1989 (Media and Public Sphere in the GDR 1989)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA9013","justification":"Study on the role of media and public communication during the political transformation year 1989 in the GDR; focuses on media structures and usage in the late 1980s."},{"title":"Zeitungsnutzung und politische Information in der DDR 1984 (Newspaper Use and Political Information in the GDR 1984)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8127","justification":"Survey about newspaper reading and political information in the GDR, fielded in 1984, centered on print media and information behavior in the mid‑1980s."},{"title":"Medienrezeption Jugendlicher in der DDR 1986 (Media Reception of Young People in the GDR 1986)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8619","justification":"Youth-focused dataset on media reception and preferences among adolescents in the GDR in 1986, directly tied to GDR media during the 1980s."},{"title":"Hörfunknutzung in der DDR 1981 (Radio Use in the GDR 1981)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gESIS.org/research_data/ZA7724","justification":"Study documenting radio listening patterns in the GDR in 1981; though early in the decade, it addresses mass media use under the GDR system."},{"title":"Medien und Alltagskultur in der DDR 1980 (Media and Everyday Culture in the GDR 1980)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7559","justification":"Dataset on the role of media within everyday culture in the GDR at the start of the 1980s, fitting both the temporal (1980s) and spatial (GDR) criteria."}]}
